caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dining table with six matching wooden chairs arranged in a row behind it. The table is rectangular with a flat top and has two central pedestal legs, each with a curved, splayed base. The chairs have slightly reclined backs with horizontal top rails and five vertical spindles connecting the seat to the backrest. The seats are flat and the legs of the chairs are slightly angled, connected by horizontal stretchers. The entire composition is rendered in shades of brown, giving the appearance of polished wood. The drawing is set against a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. There are handwritten notations in blue and gray pencil on the lower right of the page.
title: Shaker Table and Chairs
